claims.evidence: No screen/audio output shown; only front/back photos.

claims.evidence: Photos do not show the adapter; no functional test evidence (video/audio) provided.

risks.risk: Missing adapter/charger or wrong adapter type, making it unusable.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter/charger included (label showing output voltage/amps) plus a close-up of the power port on the piano.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'adapter not included / not confirmed' (worst case: buyer must source power separately).

risks.risk: Some keys/buttons may be dead or intermittent (seller says all work, but not demonstrated).
risks.proof: Short video pressing every key and each button while showing sound output (or a key-by-key test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'not fully working' (worst case: assume at least one key/button may fail).

risks.proof: Audio recording/video playing a few notes at low and higher volume, showing no crackling.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'speaker/audio not confirmed' (worst case: treat as potentially crackly).

risks.risk: Model/compatibility uncertainty (label text not readable), affecting replacement parts and comparable pricing.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the back label/model number and any brand name.
risks.if_unproven: Price using generic children’s toy electronic piano category (worst case for value due to unknown model).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the back label/model number (so we can price correctly).
Photo of the included adapter/charger (with output specs) and a close-up of the piano’s power port.
Short video: press every key and each button with sound audible (confirm no dead keys).
Short audio/video demo showing clean sound (no crackle) at different volumes.
response.reason: Even though the seller claims they tested it, there is still no new photo/video evidence to confirm adapter inclusion, key/button functionality, or no crackle, and the model label remains unreadable—so a reliable worst-case price can’t be set yet.
